description: Investigated, disclosed divergences between SBE committees' sworn D-2 cover totals and their own itemized Schedule A filings. Annotations are editorial acts with an evidence requirement -- see PIPELINE_RUNBOOK.md. Match is exact on (committee, period, residual-to-the-cent); any drift re-fires the flag; a ledger entry matching no current flag fails loudly (stale).
sign_convention: amount is the period residual = ours - d2 (negative when the committee swore more than we itemize).

gaps.reason: SBE-side: the per-committee export no longer carries the 7 itemized contribution rows it previously carried for this period. The rows are present in the archived export and absent from the current one; both bulk receipt vintages contain no row for this period of any status, and no superseding filing, amended report, archived predecessor, or changed committee id accounts for the difference. The committee's D-2 cover total continues to swear $7,650.00 in itemized receipts. The full row loss is $10,150.00 — $1,300.00 individual plus $6,350.00 loans, totalling the $7,650.00 itemized figure above, plus $2,500.00 in-kind carried separately as inkind_delta. Our figures reproduce the current export exactly. Unrecoverable by ingest.
